data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"The distinction between independent and correlated failures is found in the 'Entropy of Recovery'\u2014the variance in the time and method of service restoration.","counterconditions":[{"case":"The shared cause is a permanent state change (e.g., a deprecated API) requiring manual updates across all services.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"Recovery is gated by a shared dependency that recovers linearly rather than instantaneously.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"Truly independent failures exhibit high entropy in recovery; services come back online based on the individual operator's wake-up time and local fix.
